misconceptions.name: 形容词放在 something 前
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“有趣的东西”，形容词放在前面。
misconceptions.move: 规则：形容词修饰 something、anything、nothing 时放在后面；全班读一读 something interesting。

misconceptions.name: 肯定句里用了 anything
misconceptions.why: 以为 something、anything 都是“某物”，可以随便换。
misconceptions.move: 对比：I saw something.（肯定）Did you see anything?（疑问）I didn't see anything.（否定）

misconceptions.name: 问频率用了 how long
misconceptions.why: 汉语“多久”既能问多长时间，也能问多久一次。
misconceptions.move: 看答语：Twice a week 是次数还是时长？说次数用 how often。

misconceptions.name: 看到次数就用 how many
misconceptions.why: 答语里有 twice，就以为问“几次”要用 how many。
misconceptions.move: 问：How many 后面缺了什么？对比 How many times a week…? 和 How often…?

misconceptions.name: 有 than 却用了原级
misconceptions.why: 汉语“比”字句里形容词不变：她比姐姐外向。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 than，问：两个人在比较，后面的形容词或副词要不要变成比较级？

misconceptions.name: 多音节形容词也加 -er
misconceptions.why: 把短词加 -er 的规则用到了长词上。
misconceptions.move: 拍手数音节：out-go-ing 三个音节，要在前面加 more。

misconceptions.name: more 和 -er 一起用
misconceptions.why: 记住了 more 表示“更”，又习惯性加了 -er。
misconceptions.move: 规则：比较级只变一次，要么加 -er，要么前面加 more。

misconceptions.name: 单音节词也用 most
misconceptions.why: 记住了 the most popular，就以为最高级都加 most。
misconceptions.move: 数音节：cheap 只有一个音节，直接加 -est。

misconceptions.name: 最高级前漏了 the
misconceptions.why: 汉语没有冠词，“城里最便宜的影院”前面不用加词。
misconceptions.move: 规则：最高级修饰名词时前面加 the；圈出 in our town，提示这是在一个范围里比。

misconceptions.name: most 和 -est 一起用
misconceptions.why: 记住了 most 表示“最”，又习惯性加了 -est。
misconceptions.move: 规则：最高级只变一次，要么加 -est，要么前面加 most。

misconceptions.name: enjoy 后接了 to do
misconceptions.why: 受 want to do、plan to do 影响，以为都接 to do。
misconceptions.move: 列两栏：plan、want、hope、expect + to do；enjoy + doing，让学生把 enjoy 放进对的一栏。

misconceptions.name: plan 后接了 doing
misconceptions.why: 受 enjoy doing、like watching 影响，以为都接 -ing。
misconceptions.move: 用同一张两栏表，让学生把 plan 放进对的一栏，再各造一句。

misconceptions.name: 两个动词直接连在一起
misconceptions.why: 汉语“打算看电影”两个动词直接连用，形式不变。
misconceptions.move: 问：第二个动词前要加 to 还是改成 -ing？先看第一个动词是谁。

misconceptions.name: going to 后直接接名词
misconceptions.why: 以为 is going to 已经包含“打算当”的意思，漏了动词 be。
misconceptions.move: 问：going to 后面要接动词原形，“当”用哪个动词？be。

misconceptions.name: going to 前漏了 be 动词
misconceptions.why: 把 going to 当成一个现成的词，忘了前面要随主语加 am/is/are。
misconceptions.move: 板书 I am / he is / they are going to…，让学生圈出 be。

misconceptions.name: 将来的“有”说成 will have
misconceptions.why: 汉语“将会有”直译成了 will have。
misconceptions.move: 先说现在时 There are robots.，再把 are 换成 will be。

misconceptions.name: will 后用了 is/are
misconceptions.why: 知道要用 be，却按名词单复数选了 is、are。
misconceptions.move: 规则：will 后永远用原形，is、am、are 的原形都是 be。

misconceptions.name: 不可数名词用了 how many
misconceptions.why: 牛奶能论杯、论瓶数，就以为它也能直接数。
misconceptions.move: 问：能说 one milk、two milks 吗？不能直接数的用 how much。

misconceptions.name: 可数名词用了 how much
misconceptions.why: 以为问“多少”都用 how much。
misconceptions.move: 问：能说 two bananas 吗？能数的用 how many + 复数名词。

misconceptions.name: I'd love to 漏了 to
misconceptions.why: 汉语“我很乐意”说完就结束，以为 I'd love 已经完整。
misconceptions.move: 补全原句：I'd love to (come). to 后省掉了动词，to 本身不能省。

misconceptions.name: if 从句也用了 will
misconceptions.why: 条件说的是将来的事，就在 if 句里也用 will。
misconceptions.move: 讲“主将从现”：划出 if 句和主句，分别标出时态再检查。

misconceptions.name: 名词短语前也用 so
misconceptions.why: 两个词都译成“这么、如此”，以为可以随便换。
misconceptions.move: 看空后面：只有形容词（funny）用 so；有 a + 形容词 + 名词（a great evening）用 such。

misconceptions.name: 单个形容词前也用 such
misconceptions.why: 记住了 such a good experience，以为“这么”都用 such。
misconceptions.move: 让学生圈出空后面的词，问：后面有名词吗？没有名词就用 so。

misconceptions.name: 请别人做事说成 Could I
misconceptions.why: Can I…? 用得多，没分清“我可以……吗”和“你能……吗”。
misconceptions.move: 追问：灯由谁来开？要别人做用 Could you…?，问自己能不能做用 Could I…?

misconceptions.name: 请人帮忙直接用祈使句
misconceptions.why: 汉语“开一下灯”靠语气显得客气，以为英语祈使句也一样。
misconceptions.move: 两种说法各读一遍，问：同学听了哪句更愿意帮忙？求人用 Could you…, please?

misconceptions.name: could 后的动词用了过去式
misconceptions.why: 知道 could 是 can 的过去式，以为后面的动词也要变过去式。
misconceptions.move: 规则：can、could 后都用动词原形；把 turned 划掉换成 turn，全班读一遍。

misconceptions.name: 代词宾语放到 up/out 后面
misconceptions.why: 记住了 take out the rubbish 这个整体，把名词换成 it 时也照原样放在最后。
misconceptions.move: 板书 take out the rubbish = take the rubbish out = take it out，划掉 take out it，问：代词只能放在哪？

misconceptions.name: 照汉语漏掉了宾语 it
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“我这就拿出去”，不用说出“它”。
misconceptions.move: 追问：take out 什么？把 the rubbish 换成 it，再问 it 该放在哪。

misconceptions.name: 把 less…than 当成“更”
misconceptions.why: 比较级都译成“更”，看到形容词加 than 就忽略了 less。
misconceptions.move: 在黑板上画一条“外向”的线，把 Mia 和姐姐标上去；再换成 not as outgoing as 说一遍。

misconceptions.name: 名词的位置直接用了形容词
misconceptions.why: 汉语“重要”“重要性”常混用，没注意 the ____ of 中间要填名词。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 the 和 of，问：夹在中间的是什么词性？再说出 important 的名词形式。

misconceptions.name: 形容词变名词都加 -ness
misconceptions.why: 记住了 kind → kindness，就以为都加 -ness。
misconceptions.move: 列 -ance、-(t)ion、-ness、-ity 四栏，让学生把 important、connect、kind、popular 的名词放进去读一读。

misconceptions.name: 量词短语里瓶、杯没变复数
misconceptions.why: 汉语“三瓶”的“瓶”不变，就照搬成 three bottle。
misconceptions.move: 问：bottle 能数吗？三个瓶子怎么写？复数加在量词上，milk 不动。

misconceptions.name: 把 hardly 当成“努力地”
misconceptions.why: hard 加 -ly 像是副词，就以为 hardly 是“努力地”。
misconceptions.move: 对比两句：He works hard.（努力地干）He hardly works.（几乎不干），问意思差在哪。

misconceptions.name: 没看出 hardly 表示否定
misconceptions.why: 句子里没有 not，又看到 ever，就当成“一直”。
misconceptions.move: 把 hardly ever 换成 almost never 读一遍，问：never 是“总是”还是“从不”？

misconceptions.name: 可数名词复数前用了 less
misconceptions.why: 汉语“更少”只有一个说法，以为 less 什么名词都能配。
misconceptions.move: 问：cars 能数吗？能数的用 fewer（对应 many），不能数的用 less（对应 much）。

misconceptions.name: 不可数名词前用了 fewer
misconceptions.why: 刚学了 fewer，就以为“更少”都用 fewer。
misconceptions.move: 问：能说 two pollutions 吗？不能数的用 less。

misconceptions.name: 把 fewer、less 的分工记反
misconceptions.why: 两个词都是“更少”，记住了有分工，却对错了号。
misconceptions.move: 板书两条链：many → more → fewer，much → more → less，让学生给每条链各接一个名词。

misconceptions.name: 以为 they 只能指人
misconceptions.why: 汉语分“他们”和“它们”，就以为 they 只是“他们”，先去找人。
misconceptions.move: 问：什么东西“容易读”？把 their notes 代回句子读一读，they 也能指东西。

misconceptions.name: 代词就近找名词，不看单复数
misconceptions.why: 习惯往前找离代词最近的那个名词。
misconceptions.move: 问：They 是单数还是复数？the class 是几个？再往前找复数名词。

items.lesson: Section A How do people spend their holidays ?
lessons: How do people spend their holidays
right: 形容词修饰 something 等不定代词时放在后面；
肯定句用 something：something interesting。
typical: “有趣的东西”，形容词放前面：
We saw interesting something.

ladder.q: 用 something 或 anything 填空：There's ____ (new) on the blackboard.
用 something 或 anything 填空：I didn't buy ____ (special) for myself.
I have ____ ____ to do today.（我今天没什么特别的事要做。）

items.lesson: Section A How are we different from each other?
lessons: How are we different from each other
right: 有 than，要用比较级；
outgoing 是多音节词，前面加 more：more outgoing。
typical: 比较级就是加 -er：
Tina is outgoinger than her sister.

ladder.q: Tom is ____ (tall) than Sam.
This book is ____ (interesting) than that one.
I'm ____ (good) at math than my brother, but he's ____ (funny).

items.lesson: Section A What can plants and animals do?
lessons: What can plants and animals do
items.stem: This is ____ movie theater in our town.
right: cheap 是单音节词，最高级加 -est；
最高级修饰名词，前面要加 the：the cheapest。
typical: 最高级就是在前面加 the most：
the most cheap movie theater

ladder.q: This is ____ (big) shop in our town.
Which is ____ (good) movie theater near here?
Of all the students, Mike is ____ (funny).

items.lesson: Section A When do we make plans?
items.stem: Jack plans ____ a movie tonight. He enjoys ____ action movies.
right: plan 后接 to do：plans to watch；
enjoy 后接 doing：enjoys watching。
typical: 两个空都跟 plan 一样用 to do：
to watch; to watch

ladder.q: I hope ____ (see) you again.
My parents enjoy ____ (watch) the news after dinner.
She enjoys ____ (read), and she wants ____ (learn) French.

items.lesson: Section A When do we make plans?
items.stem: “他长大后打算当医生。”He ____ a doctor when he grows up.
right: be going to + 动词原形；“当”要用 be：
He is going to be a doctor.
typical: “打算当”就是 is going to：
He is going to a doctor.

ladder.q: 用 be going to 填空：I ____ (visit) my grandparents this weekend.
—What ____ you going to ____ when you grow up? —An engineer.
改成一般疑问句：They're going to be teachers.
ladder.a: Are they going to be teachers?

items.lesson: Section A What are your predictions about the future?
lessons: What are your predictions about the future
items.stem: “将来会有更多的机器人。”哪句对？
right: there be 的将来时是 there will be，
will 后用原形 be：There will be more robots.
typical: “会有”就是 will have：
There will have more robots.

ladder.q: There ____ ____ a test tomorrow.
—____ there be robots in every home? —Yes, there will.
People ____ (have) robots at home in 50 years.

items.lesson: Section A How do we make food?
items.stem: ____ bananas and ____ milk do we need?
right: bananas 可数，用 how many；
milk 不可数，用 how much。
typical: 牛奶也能一杯一杯地数：
How many bananas and how many milk…?

ladder.q: ____ yogurt do we need?
____ apples do you want?
____ cups of milk do we need?

items.lesson: Section A How do we communicate?
items.stem: 朋友邀请小明，小明这样回答。你同意吗？
work: —Can you come to my birthday party this Friday?
right: I'd love to. 是 I'd love to come. 的省略，
to 不能省：Sure, I'd love to.

ladder.q: —Would you like to go hiking? —Yes, I'd like ____.
—Can you go to the movies with us? —I'd love ____, but I have to study.
—Can you help me with my English? —I'd be glad ____.

items.lesson: Section A How do we communicate?
items.stem: 用 if 把 It will rain tomorrow. 和 We will stay at home. 连成一句。小明从第几步开始错？
work: “明天下雨”是条件，用 if 引出
从句照搬原句：If it will rain tomorrow,
主句用一般将来时：we will stay at home.
合起来：If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
right: if 条件句“主将从现”：if 句用一般现在时，
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

ladder.q: If you ____ (study) hard, you'll pass the test.
If it ____ (be) sunny tomorrow, we ____ (go) hiking.
If she ____ (not get) up early, she ____ (miss) the bus.

items.lesson: Section B What can we learn from holiday experiences?
lessons: What can we learn from holiday experiences
items.topic: so 与 such 怎么选
items.stem: The film was ____ funny that we laughed all the way home. It was ____ a great evening!
right: funny 是形容词，前面用 so：so funny that…
a great evening 是名词短语，前面用 such：such a great evening。
typical: 两个“这么”都用 so：
It was so a great evening!

ladder.q: 填 so 或 such：The soup is ____ hot that I can't eat it.
填 so 或 such：She is ____ a kind girl that everyone likes her.
用 such…that 合成一句：It was a hot day. We stayed at home.
ladder.a: It was such a hot day that we stayed at home.

items.lesson: Section A What can you do for your home?
lessons: What can you do for your home
items.stem: 你两手抱着书，想请同学帮你把灯打开。哪句说得最得体？
options: Could I turn on the light, please?
Could you please turned on the light?
Could you turn on the light, please?
right: 请别人帮你做事，用 Could you + 动词原形…?
Could you turn on the light, please?
typical: 想让灯亮，就问“能开灯吗”：
Could I turn on the light, please?

ladder.q: 填 I 或 you：Could ____ please sweep the floor?（请妈妈扫地）
填 I 或 you：Can ____ use your phone?（问朋友能不能借手机用）
想请哥哥擦窗户，改写这句：Could I clean the windows?
ladder.a: Could you clean the windows, please?

items.lesson: Section B How do you feel at home?
lessons: How do you feel at home
items.stem: —The rubbish bin is full. Could you help? —Sure, I'll ____ now.
right: take out 的宾语是代词时，代词要放在中间：
take it out（不能说 take out it）。
typical: 记住了 take out the rubbish，换成 it 也放在最后：
I'll take out it now.

ladder.q: 用 it 改写：Please clean up the kitchen. → Please ____.
用 them 改写：Can you hang up the photos? → Can you ____?
—My books are all over the desk. —OK, I'll ____ (pack up) now.

items.lesson: Section B How do we understand differences?
items.stem: 小明这样理解下面这句话。你同意吗？
work: Mia is less outgoing than her sister.
小明：意思是姐姐比 Mia 更外向。
right: less + 形容词 + than 表示“不如……”：
Mia 不如姐姐外向，也就是姐姐比 Mia 更外向。

ladder.q: This box is less heavy than that one. 哪个箱子更重？
同义改写：Mia is less outgoing than her sister. = Mia is not as ____ as her sister.
用 less…than 写：我没有哥哥那么认真（serious）。
ladder.a: I am less serious than my brother.

items.lesson: Section B How are plants and animals connected with us?
lessons: How are plants and animals connected with us
items.stem: 用 important 的名词形式填空：Bees show us the ____ of small animals.
right: the ____ of 中间要填名词；
important 的名词是 importance（-ant 变 -ance）。
typical: 形容词变名词就加 -ness：
the importantness of small animals

ladder.q: 写出名词：dark → ____
写出名词：active → ____
用 invent 的适当形式填空：The ____ of paper changed the world.

items.lesson: Section B What does cooking give us?
items.stem: 用英语写在纸上：三瓶牛奶
right: milk 不可数，复数加在量词 bottle 上：
three bottles of milk
typical: 汉语“三瓶”的“瓶”不变，英语照搬：
three bottle of milk

ladder.q: 用英语写：两碗米饭
用英语写：五片面包
We need ____（三袋面粉）and ____（两勺糖）.
ladder.a: three bags of flour；two spoons of sugar

items.lesson: Section B How can we make good plans?
lessons: How can we make good plans
items.stem: Tom makes a study plan every week, but he hardly ever follows it. 意思是？
options: 他很努力地按计划去做
他几乎从来不按计划做
right: hardly ever = almost never，“几乎从不”：
他每周都订计划，却几乎从来不照着做。
typical: hardly 是 hard 加 -ly，“努力地”：
他很努力地按计划去做。

ladder.q: hardly ever 和哪个意思相同：always / almost never / often？
He is very busy, so he ____ ____ watches TV.（他几乎从不看电视）
按频率从高到低排：hardly ever, always, sometimes, usually

items.lesson: Section B How can we prepare for the future?
lessons: How can we prepare for the future
items.stem: In the future, there will be ____ cars on the road and ____ pollution.
right: cars 可数，用 fewer；
pollution 不可数，用 less。
typical: “更少”就是 less：
less cars on the road and less pollution

ladder.q: 填 fewer 或 less：I want to eat ____ sugar.
填 fewer 或 less：There are ____ students in Class 2 than in Class 1.
We should drink ____ sugary drinks and eat ____ fast food.

items.lesson: Section B How can we communicate better?
items.stem: My classmates lent me their notes after I missed the class. They were easy to read. They 指什么？
right: They 是复数，“容易读”的是笔记：
They = their notes。
typical: They 离 the class 最近，
所以 They 指那节课。

ladder.q: I bought a new kite. It flies very high. It 指什么？
My parents gave me two books. I put them on my desk. them 指什么？
Tom asked Amy for help, and she said yes. Then he thanked her. she、her 各指谁？
